title: Putin Meets Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow to Discuss Ukraine War
summary: President Vladimir V. Putin ordered a pause in strikes on Ukraine’s capital, Kyiv, ahead of the meeting with President Trump’s envoys: his son-in-law Jared Kushner and the businessman Steve Witkoff.
